payload.summary: Found during afk-run-workflow (yc7cahha): task-lifecycle.md, prd-parse.md, and epic-decompose.md each ship a 'nahel log note --item <id> --data body=...' example — but body is a reserved mutation payload key and the CLI exits 1 on it. Any agent following those docs verbatim hits a refusal. Fix: switch the examples to summary= (afk-run.md already uses it) and add a doc-content regression test asserting no workflow doc uses --data body=. Orchestrator hit this live earlier today (prd-parse journal-link step failed with the exact error).
